data.text:
Vinod Ramchandra Gangwani vs The State Of Maharashtra on 
25 January, 2024 
Author: N. R. Borkar
Bench: Anuja Prabhudessai, N. R. Borkar
 22-wpst-183-24.doc
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Writ Petition (St) No. 183 Of 2024
 Vinod R. Gangwani ...Petitioner
 Versus
 State of Maharashtra ...Respondent
 Mr. Tushar Sonawane a/w. Ms Pooja Satpute for the Petitioner. 
 Mr. Ajay Patil, App for the Respondent/State. 
 Coram : Smt Anuja Prabhudessai &
 N. R. Borkar, Jj.
Dated : 25 January 2024. 
Pc:-
1. Heard. Admit. 
2. The petitioner seeks quashing of Fir No. 797 of 2023 registered at Kolsewadi
Police Station, Thane city for ofences under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 read with 34
of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(a), 27(3)(c), 30(2) of the Food
Safety and Standard Act, 2006. 
3.  Learned counsel for the petitioner states that the issue regarding applicability of Section 328 of the IPC is pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court. 
4. He submits that the petitions, i.e., Criminal Writ Petition Nos.4030 of 2023, 3934 of 2023, 3936 of 2023 and 3935 of 2023, challenging similar ofence have been admitted and stayed since the issue of applicability of Section 328 of the IPC is pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court.
